newsitem.title: USA: IntegraMed files for $10 million placement.
newsitem.headline: IntegraMed files for $10 million placement.

text.p: IntegraMed America Inc said on Tuesday it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a registration statement covering the direct placement of newly issued common shares to selected insitutional investors for about $10 million.
Vector Securities International Inc would serve as placement agent for the proposed offering, IntegraMed said.
A substantial portion of the proceeds would be used for its previously announced acquisition of Fertility Centers of Illinois SC, the company said.
IntegraMed is a physician practice management company specializing in women's health care. Its shares closed up 1/8 to 1-7/8 on Tuesday.
